text:
Summary: Credential disclosure in demo-thirdparty/file-diff.

Severity: Critical.

Affected versions: v1, v2 and v3.
Patched versions: v4.

The affected Action versions execute a payload that dumps runner memory and secrets to the build log. Anyone able to read the log may recover credentials available to the runner, including workflow tokens and temporary cloud credentials.

Upgrade to v4, pin the reviewed commit, and rotate credentials exposed by affected runs. Restrict access to affected build logs while investigating.
